mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP450 enzymes and may increase metabolism of piperacillin, potentially reducing antibiotic efficacy, while piperacillin-tazobactam may displace phenobarbital from protein binding increasing free levels.
action: Monitor clinical response to antibiotic therapy and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of phenobarbital levels; ensure adequate piperacillin-tazobactam dosing for infection site penetration.
